qa_pairs.question: What pin on the universal adapter is used for the ignition final stage ground connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Pin 1 (term. 1) on the universal adapter is used for the ignition final stage ground connection.

qa_pairs.question: What test equipment is needed to check the signal on Pin 1 for ignition final stage testing?
qa_pairs.answer: An oscilloscope is needed to check the signal while cranking the engine with the starting motor.

qa_pairs.question: What corrective measure should be taken if the ignition final stage tests are okay up to this point?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace the DME control unit if tests up to this point are okay.

qa_pairs.question: Which pins are used for testing the final stage of fuel injectors for cylinder 2-4-6 on the M20 engine?
qa_pairs.answer: Pins 17 / 14 are used for testing the final stage of fuel injectors for cylinder 2-4-6 (M20 engine).

qa_pairs.question: What additional tests should be performed besides checking the signal with an oscilloscope for fuel injector testing?
qa_pairs.answer: Check plug connections and leads for fuel injectors, and test the fuel injectors themselves.

qa_pairs.question: Which cylinders are tested using pins 16 / 14 for fuel injector final stage testing?
qa_pairs.answer: Pins 16 / 14 are used for testing the final stage of fuel injectors for cylinders 1-3-5 on the M20 engine.

qa_pairs.question: What type of engine designation is specified for the fuel injector testing procedures shown?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel injector testing procedures are specified for the M20 engine.

qa_pairs.question: What components should be checked in addition to the oscilloscope signal test for ignition final stage diagnosis?
qa_pairs.answer: Check the power supply for ignition coil, ignition coil, distributor and leads, and spark plugs.

qa_pairs.question: What is the recommended corrective action if fuel injector final stage tests are satisfactory?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace the DME control unit if tests up to this point are okay.

qa_pairs.question: What diagnostic tool is consistently specified for checking signals in all the test procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: An oscilloscope is consistently specified for checking signals in all the test procedures shown.

qa_pairs.question: How should the engine be operated when testing Pin 1 for ignition final stage ground?
qa_pairs.answer: Crank the engine with the starting motor while checking the signal with an oscilloscope.

qa_pairs.question: What page number is shown at the top of this service manual section?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 12-112/3 is shown at the top of this service manual section.
